title: 原世精进：红石patch for redstone
description: Just for fun — an AI-made mod that adds new redstone gameplay without any new blocks. Everything blends right into vanilla redstone!
body:
## Patch for Redstone
An AI-generated “just for fun” mod that adds new redstone mechanics without adding any new blocks — everything blends nicely into vanilla!
## Warning:
Heavily uses Mixins, so compatibility is pretty bad. 100% AI-coded, full of bugs, and probably unstable.
For entertainment only! If you want to try it, please create a new world and backup often.

## Features:
- Copper now requires different redstone signal strengths to activate depending on how rusty it is.
- Copper wrapped in gold or netherite oxidizes much faster when hit by potions.
- You can now wax copper using resin.
- Comparators have two modes and read different block data in each.
- Note blocks make amethyst above them resonate according to the current note.
- Wind charges now affect more blocks.
- Recovery Compass has been turned into a Totem of Undying that directly sends you back to your last death location.
- When a Warden dies, it drops a sculk shrieker that can summon another Warden.
